desc: 暖麻橡木台面晨光掠射的磨砂瓶身尖顶罩盖奶瓶，九屏留白式详情
leaf: 磨砂直身瓶身尖顶透明罩盖宽口径奶瓶
name: 暖麻驼光尖顶罩盖奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用暖麻布搭橡木台与赤陶晨光一次交代尖顶透明罩盖和宽瓶盖环，在暖掠射光里抢到首屏停留
shots.textZone: 上部留白带放一条明体中文主标，主标正下方一行小型大写宽字距拉丁眉题，眉题下一条发丝线

shots.intent: 把选购时的三个疑问做成三块折叠布面板，裸排数字编号索引，条目全部交给占位符，不复述源图的恐吓式与材质式断言
shots.textZone: 顶部一条明体中文标题加一行小型大写拉丁眉题，三块布面板各一枚裸排数字编号与一行空白标签位

shots.intent: 用右侧低掠射微距交代尖顶罩盖、瓶盖环与坐在瓶口内的奶嘴的装配关系，赤陶点引线撑起做工信任而不写任何材质与功效
shots.textZone: 四周四枚赤陶点引线标签位，左下一条明体结构小标题

shots.intent: 用同一块麻布折出的三道褶皱台把对照做成层次结构而非硬质台阶，两档留白给卖家自贴，避免虚构对手品与胜负结论
shots.textZone: 顶部一条对照标题与一行小型大写拉丁眉题，两档留布面板各一枚空白标签与一枚裸排数字编号位

shots.intent: 放进暖晨光居家橡木桌语境让人代入，成人从肩下取景、孩子只留背影且全程被托抱看护，仅留一条克制小标
shots.textZone: 上部虚焦墙面的留白里放一条克制的明体小标与一行小型大写拉丁眉题，其余不写

shots.intent: 以后侧四十五度三分之四交代直身瓶身、肩部收势与透过瓶身可见的内密封圈与空白标签区，结构条目全部占位
shots.textZone: 右侧一列：一条明体造型小标题加一行小型大写拉丁眉题与两枚赤陶点引线标签位，底部一条发丝线

shots.intent: 复刻源图的信任屏结构但改为俯视平铺麻布上一块整面空白留证布块与四枚赤陶点引线，任何证书与检测信息一律留空由卖家自贴
shots.textZone: 顶部一条明体标题与一行小型大写拉丁眉题，四枚赤陶点引线各带一行空白标签，下方一整块空白留证布块

shots.intent: 把参考图里真实存在的两档瓶盖环色调并排成立款屏，选款点留空且不新造任何颜色、不复述色调名
shots.textZone: 两瓶下方各一枚赤陶点与一条空白选款标签，顶部一条明体选款小标题加一行拉丁眉题

shots.intent: 以二十五度俯角收口整套暖麻视觉并留出一枚暖色行动卡，把加购引导交给不编造事实的占位符
shots.textZone: 上部留白带放结束明体标题、一行小型大写拉丁眉题、一枚空白暖色行动卡与两枚赤陶点引线标签位

style.backgroundSystem: a domestic warm interior only: undyed oatmeal linen #EDE0C8 cloth loosely draped over a honeyed-oak #B98A54 plank tabletop with an open matte grain, and a softly blurred warm linen wall falling out of focus behind; the ground is real folded cloth and real wood with honest contact shadows, never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never stacked steps or block tiers, never a podium or sphere still life, never a gradient card, never a cool, metallic or dark field
style.direction: warm linen-and-oak maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce
style.iconSystem: no boxed iconography at all: index and step markers are bare large serif numerals sitting on a single hairline rule, and callout leaders are one thin warm rule ending in a single small solid terracotta #B0603A dot placed directly on the referenced part; never a frame, never a squircle chip, never a pill, never a diamond or hollow square, never a medal, rosette or star, never a second line weight
style.lightingSystem: warm morning-window key around 3900K: a low raking key entering from camera right at tabletop height so it skims across the linen weave and the oak grain, balanced by a warm bounce lifting off the oak surface below, throwing one long soft shadow pooling to camera left; one true warm contact shadow under the base, soft falloff, no mirror reflection, no cool cast and no front-top wash, medium contrast

no color palette changes, no cool bluish-family or pastel floral-family hue, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no limewash plaster, no arched niche, no stacked steps, no podium or sphere, no dark scenes, no new product colors, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no origin or import claim: no country name, no 「进口」 wording, no foreign-lab or flag artwork
no medical or functional-benefit wording: no anti-colic, no 防胀气, no 倒气, no 智能奶嘴, no 不吸瘪, no 拒吃, no 吐奶, no relief, cure or digestion phrasing and no breastfeeding-equivalence phrasing
no age indication: no month or year range, no 「新生儿」, no 「宝宝专用」, no suitability statement about a child
no material or safety grade claim: no PPSU, PES, glass, borosilicate, silicone grade, food-grade, BPA or BBA wording, no 「不含」 or 「安全无毒」 assertion and no surface-performance claim
no sterilisation, disinfection, antibacterial or high-temperature standard and no sterilisation-rate percentage or pathogen name of any kind
no certificate, authorisation letter, award, medal, rosette, star badge, inspection seal, test report or report, registration or execution-standard number

no invented numbers: no capacity, dimension, pack count, piece count, shelf life, temperature, time, percentage, multiple, bar chart, comparison result, price, discount, coupon, countdown or delivery time

no visible infant face and no adult face: a child appears only from behind or cropped above the jaw, always held and supervised by an anonymous adult framed from the shoulders down; the bottle is never at a child's mouth and never left unattended
no loose, detached or unsecured nipple and no exploded parts: the nipple stays seated inside the closed dome in every screen
no microwave, no steam, no hot liquid or water touching skin, no water splash, no liquid jets or droplet sprays
no brand name, store name, logo, material-site watermark, membership corner, QR code or platform sticker

no drift between screens: no palette change, no mixed fonts, no limewash plaster, no arched niche, no stacked steps or block tiers, no podium or sphere still life, no gradient card, no boxed or squircle icon chips, no pills, no diamonds or hollow squares, no cool front-top wash, no cool bluish-family or pastel floral-family hue anywhere, no recoloured product and no new colourway
style.presentationRules: the bottle stands upright at a stable scale on the linen and oak with the tall pointed clear dome fitted, the wide collar ring screwed closed and the nipple fully seated inside the dome; the frosted milk-white #F1EAD9 straight body with its soft shoulder taper, the collar ring tone, the inner seal ring visible through the body, the original dome height and base radius are never redrawn; the reference set shows two collar-ring colourways, one cooler and one warmer, and no third colour may be invented, the ring always keeping its exact reference tone with no recolouring; any graduation or scale marking stays exactly as shot and is never added or removed; the label area always reads as one blank legible field with no redrawn wording; the product never floats without its warm contact shadow, never is occluded by props, one real scale anchor sits in every scene shot and vertical lines stay vertical
style.surfaceSystem: honeyed-oak plank #B98A54 with an open matte grain under a slubby undyed oatmeal linen #EDE0C8 runner with natural folds; the frosted bottle settles into the cloth with real weight and soft fabric shading around its base, no gloss floor and no reflection
style.typography: one warm editorial serif pairing throughout: a Chinese Ming/Song-style serif headline in espresso #45301F with generous leading, set above one small-caps wide-tracked Latin kicker line; section entries are separated by single hairline rules; no highlighter bands, no filled square bullets, no dot-pagination markers, no double-rule keyline frames and no label pills; a single family voice only, no mixed fonts
